description_en: You can call the SetCenInterRegionBandwidthLimit operation to set, modify, or delete the inter-region bandwidth between two regions in a bandwidth plan for a Basic Edition transit router
description_zh: 调用SetCenInterRegionBandwidthLimit接口设置、修改或删除基础版转发路由器带宽包中两个地域间的跨地域互通带宽
kebab_example: aliyun cbn set-cen-inter-region-bandwidth-limit --cen-id cen-7qthudw0ll6jmx0000 --local-region-id cn-hangzhou --opposite-region-id us-west-1 --bandwidth-limit 8 --bandwidth-type BandwidthPackage --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetCenInterRegionBandwidthLimit

parameters.help_en: The ID of the CEN instance
parameters.name: cen_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the local region.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/132080.html operation to query the regions where network instances can be attached to a CEN instance
parameters.help_zh:
本端地域ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/132080.html接口获取云企业网支持加载的网络实例的地域信息
parameters.name: local_region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the peer region
parameters.name: opposite_region_id

parameters.help_en: The inter-region bandwidth between the two regions. Unit: Mbps
parameters.help_zh: 两个地域之间的跨地域互通带宽。单位：Mbps
parameters.name: bandwidth_limit

parameters.help_en:
The method used to allocate bandwidth. Valid value:

BandwidthPackage (default): allocates bandwidth from a bandwidth plan
parameters.help_zh:
带宽的分配方式。取值：

BandwidthPackage（默认值）：从带宽包中分配带宽
parameters.name: bandwidth_type
